title: Minimax Calibration Distance under Simultaneous Play

comparators.scope: 55 literal independently stated mathematical contracts covering both actual minimax protocols, exact grid optimizer, horizon-free predictor, witness bounds and exact word-RAM tree implementation.
Adds a natural-number domain premise to deterministic_minimax_one.
Proves deterministic_minimax_one using an unauthorized False axiom.

main_results.scope: For T ≥ 2, the randomized simultaneous and deterministic oblivious minimax values have lower bounds sqrt(T)/4320 and sqrt(T)/1200, and share the optimized positive-grid upper bound strictly below sqrt(T).
One causal infinite forecaster achieves calibration distance below (2+sqrt(2))sqrt(T) for every binary outcome path and positive prefix.
The actual fixed-string randomized minimax value; the quantifier-order counterexample does not establish its open square-root lower bound.
The interval-domain Lipschitz witness comparison uses genuine least constants and supremum norm.

The mean-reverting auxiliary Bernoulli trajectory gives the randomized lower estimate for arbitrary Borel behavioral kernels; a separate uniform-tape argument extracts a deterministic past-only adversary.
The deterministic forecaster has zero forecast innovation and satisfies the auxiliary lower estimate with constant 1/1200; a separate averaging argument selects one fixed binary string.
The stored grid bias equals the actual cumulative proxy residual, linking the single-coordinate recursion to the shifted-bias invariant.
The grid trajectory satisfies its shifted-bias invariant and comparison with a perfectly calibrated bin-mean proxy.
For every binary path, the causal midpoint grid has loss at most T/(2m)+(m−1)/2.
The explicit positive-integer grid optimizer minimizes the source objective; the rounding identity gives the strict square-root bound.
The bounded integer execution reproduces the mathematical grid trajectory; exact cached-tree record, word-width and initialization bounds are separate implementation theorems in the same model.
Calibration distance is subadditive under arbitrary finite partitions, including consecutive blocks.

model_boundaries.finite_horizon_encoding: Behavioral strategies are encoded on all n; each T law reads only its first T transitions. A finite-horizon family may extend by an arbitrary constant probability kernel after T, without restricting any source strategy. Strategies at each T can depend on T.
model_boundaries.word_ram: Source unit-cost word arithmetic/record access and continuation/root-handle model. Formal exact quantities are record visits, word widths, actual suspended-job work/deadline and arena footprints. No compiler/GC wall-clock theorem is asserted.
model_boundaries.implementation_variant: Cached complete binary trees implement the same grid choices and forecasts; no unformalized balanced-tree complexity theorem is assumed.
model_boundaries.randomized_oblivious: No square-root randomized-oblivious lower bound is claimed.
